description: This file defines various classes and methods for message output handling in a software system, including console, syslog, file, and JSON formats, as well as UDP network communication. It includes implementations for converting metadata to string formats, outputting messages to different sinks, and managing network message transmission.

classes.name: Text
classes.description: Class responsible for converting message metadata to string representations with optional abbreviation and timestamp formatting.

classes.name: ConsoleOutput
classes.description: Class handling message output to the console (stdout).

classes.name: SyslogOutput
classes.description: Class for sending messages to syslog or standard output on Windows.

classes.name: FileOutput
classes.description: Class for writing messages to a file output stream.

classes.name: JSON
classes.description: Namespace containing method for converting message metadata into JSON format, with configurable output options.

classes.name: UDPOutput
classes.description: Namespace with UDP message transmission capabilities, including a nested 'Channel' class for datagram handling.

classes.name: UDPOutput::Channel
classes.description: Handles UDP datagram channel operations, including sending data.

methods.name: Convert
methods.description: Converts message metadata into a string, either abbreviated or detailed with timestamp and file info.

methods.name: Message
methods.description: Outputs a message to a specific sink (console, syslog, file, network) with provided metadata and text.

methods.name: Convert (JSON)
methods.description: Converts message metadata into a JSON object, including optional fields based on output options.

methods.name: SendData
methods.description: Sends buffered UDP data, limited by maximum send size.

methods.name: Output
methods.description: Prepares and triggers sending a message over UDP.
